functions.name: ReadSingleIntoLocalFile
functions.docs: Create a context to read a non-hierarchical config into the given local FConfigFile, optionally for another platform

functions.name: ReadIntoGConfig
functions.docs: Create a context to read a hierarchical config into GConfig. Only for current platform.

functions.name: ForceReloadIntoGConfig
functions.docs: Create a context to read a hierarchical config into GConfig. Only for current platform.

functions.name: ReadSingleIntoGConfig
functions.docs: Create a context to read a non-hierarchical config into GConfig. Only for current platform.

functions.name: ReadIntoConfigSystem
functions.docs: Create a context to read a hierarchical config into the given ConfigSystem structure - usually will be for other platforms

functions.name: ReadSingleIntoConfigSystem
functions.docs: Create a context to read a non-hierarchical config into the given ConfigSystem structure - usually will be for other platforms

functions.name: ReadIntoPluginFile
functions.signature: ReadIntoPluginFile(Dest Config File, Plugin Root Dir, Child Plugins Base Dirs, Platform)
functions.docs: Create a context to read a plugin's ini file named for the plugin. This is not used for inserting, say, Engine.ini into GConfig

functions.name: ReadPluginIntoConfigSystem
functions.signature: ReadPluginIntoConfigSystem(Config System, Plugin Name, Plugin Root Dir, Child Plugins Base Dirs)
functions.docs: Inserts plugin ini files into an existing Branch

functions.name: ReadPluginToModifyConfigSystem
functions.signature: ReadPluginToModifyConfigSystem(Config System, Priority, Plugin Name, Plugin Root Dir, Child Plugins Base Dirs, Change Tracker)
functions.docs: Inserts plugin ini files into an existing Branch

functions.name: ReadUpToBeforeFile
functions.signature: ReadUpToBeforeFile(Dest Config File, Platform, Start Skipping At Filename)
functions.docs:
Create a context to read a hierarchy, but once it reaches the given filename (StartDeletingFilename), it will not read in anymore
files at that point

functions.name: FixupBranchAfterBinaryConfig
functions.docs:
Create a context to read only the saved/generated file (eg. <Project>/Saved/Windows/Input.ini) and commandline options after loading
a binary config, that was of course made without saved files and commandline options

functions.name: EnsureRequiredGlobalPathsHaveBeenInitialized
functions.docs: Call to make before attempting parallel config init

functions.name: VisualizeHierarchy
functions.signature: VisualizeHierarchy(Ar, Ini Name, Override Platform, Override Project Or Program Data Dir, Override Plugin Dir, Child Plugin Base Dirs)

params.name: Override Project Or Program Data Dir

functions.docs: Log out the config full hierarchy of a file, with various overrides to see other projects/platforms/etc hierarchies

functions.name: Load
functions.docs:
Use the context to perform the actual load operation. Note that this is where you specify the Ini name (for instance "Engine"), meaning
you can use the same context for multiple configs (Engine, Game, Input, etc)

functions.name: Load
functions.docs:
Use the context to perform the actual load operation as above, but will return the generated final ini filename (in the case of GConfig, this would
be the key used to look up into GConfig, for example)

functions.name: GetPerPlatformDirs
functions.docs: Return the paths to use to find hierarchical config files for the given platform (note that these are independent of the ini name)
